component.name: Otomedius
component.summary: Native Linux recompilation of the Otomedius arcade shooter

description.p: A native Linux recompilation of the 2008 Konami arcade shooter Otomedius. The original 32-bit Windows code is translated to C on your own machine, from your own copy of the game, and runs without Wine, without an emulator and without an interpreter.
This package contains no part of the game: no original executable, no data files and no generated code. You need your own copy of the arcade dump to build it.
First build of the recompilation pipeline.
